title: 08 Orbika SR-1: Y2K retro-future hardware hero
strengths: The device is drawn with real craft and reads as a product: brushed chrome body, speaker grille, knurled dial, backlit LCD with scanlines and a pixel typeface, BAND / SCAN / MEM buttons, an antenna
One idea on the page (tune the sky) carried by one wide display face (Michroma) and a plain grotesk; lime is used only where the product is live (LCD, 'SKY.', pre-order)
Specs are what a hardware company shows: RX 1525-1559 MHz, SATS 11 in view, battery 36 h, weight 212 g, ships Dec; the 'now playing' ticker is content, not decoration
slop_signals: '2,400 STATIONS NO TOWERS' round sticker overlapping the device is the one stock badge
Lime block behind 'SKY.' is the highlighted-word move (it works here because it is the LCD colour)

references.what: A camera on a stage as the whole hero, 'PRE-ORDER HAS STARTED' small, copy tiny; same product-first register
Device in a photograph with the copy kept small beside it; the product does the persuading
A rendered CRT as the hero object with content on its screen; retro hardware played straight, like our LCD
Handheld hardware hero with a small 'NEW' tag and two buttons; the mainstream version of the same pattern
